description: This file is an implementation of the PermissionService interface, providing operations related to permissions management such as retrieval, deletion, and modification of Permission entities within a sales management system.

classes.name: PermissionServiceImpl
classes.description: A service implementation class for managing permission entities, extending a generic service class and implementing the PermissionService interface, utilizing Spring's dependency injection.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Permission by its ID.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Placeholder method for saving or updating a permission (not implemented).

methods.name: deletePermission
methods.description: Deletes a permission after fetching it by ID and nullifying its associated groups.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of permissions associated with a list of group IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: Lists permissions based on specified search criteria.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a specific group from a permission's group list.
